description: This Java class defines a mapper that converts BsonDocument objects to JsonObject instances, allowing for optional key renaming of JSON objects within the mapping process. It uses a functional approach with dependency injection to specify how keys are revised.

classes.name: BsonDocumentToJsonObjectMapper
classes.description: An immutable class that maps BsonDocument objects to JsonObject instances, with customizable JSON key revision.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of BsonDocumentToJsonObjectMapper with a specified key reviser function.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Converts a BsonDocument to a JsonObject, applying the key reviser as part of the mapping process.
